title: Borj common definitions
description: Shared building blocks. Every MQTT message (except the demo clock) starts from `envelope`.

eventId.description: ULID (26 chars, Crockford base32). Unique per message; replaying the same eventId must change nothing (safety invariant 6).

utcTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, always with trailing Z.

id.description: Ward, bed, staff, device, admission and other identifiers. Synthetic only (safety invariant 7).

sourceType.description: Where the data originated. device = ward machine via gateway; manual = nurse fast entry; bedside_node = patient call node; staff_app = staff phone/board; server = ward server.

tsSource.description: Which clock produced `ts`. device_rtc is preferred; gateway/server are fallbacks when a device has no clock.

source.description: Name of the emitting component instance, e.g. gateway-sim, gateway-pi-1, node-B04, staff-app.

integrity.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of the message WITHOUT this field (keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8), using the per-device key `keyId`. Required in the demo (safety invariant 13); optional in unit tests and local development.
